description: A split rent calculator for housemates: by room size, by income or evenly, and it always adds up to the rent. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, which decides how the rent is rounded: most currencies to two decimal places, the Gulf dinars to three, JPY and KRW to none. It does not convert anything — the shares come back in the currency the rent was given in.

days.description: Days in the period the rent covers. Only matters if somebody is there for part of it.

method.description: How to divide it. `area` charges each person for their own room and splits `sharedArea` equally between everybody, which is the fair-rent answer. `income` is straight proportion to each person's income. `equal` ignores both.

area.description: Floor area of their own room, in any unit — square metres, square feet, anything — as long as everybody is measured the same way. Every method is a ratio, so the unit cancels out. Required when method is `area`.

days.description: Days they are actually there, if fewer than `days`. Their share shrinks in proportion and everybody else's grows to cover it, because the total is always the rent.

income.description: What they earn over the period. Required when method is `income`. Zero is allowed and means they pay nothing.

name.description: Whose share this is. Returned as given.

rent.description: The rent for the whole period, in major units — 1400 means 1400.00, not 14.00. Every share returned is in the same units.

sharedArea.description: Floor area nobody has to themselves — kitchen, hallway, sitting room — in the same unit as the rooms, split equally. Only used when method is `area`. Zero gives the simpler split where the whole rent follows bedroom size alone.

name: split_rent
title: Split Rent Calculator
